title: The ONE File: Design Concept and Finite Element Analysis of a Novel Sixth-Generation 3-Dimensional-Printed Thermoplastic Polyurethane Hollow Lattice Endodontic Instrument with Combined Rotational-Vibrational Motion
html: Endodontic instrumentation has evolved through 5 technological generations, each addressing the shortcomings of its predecessor. This study proposes the theoretical construct of a sixth generation—the ONE File—a 3-dimensional-printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) hollow diamond-lattice endodontic instrument designed for combined rotational-vibrational motion. We aimed to evaluate, through finite element analysis, the stress distribution, deformation behavior, and biomechanical safety of the ONE File compared with a ProTaper Gold F2 instrument (PTG-F2; Dentsply Sirona; D0 0.25 mm, taper 0.08, gold-wire heat-treated nickel-titanium [NiTi]).
